implementation.targetScope: Browser JWT header/payload JSON decoding, current named exports and app-pinned default import, public errors and generic declarations. Decoding does not validate a signature or claims.

changes: Independent zero-dependency implementation using native base64 and UTF-8 facilities; no upstream runtime copied.
Finds only the requested token segment without allocating a split array for the signature.
ASCII JSON skips UTF-8 conversion; Unicode uses TextDecoder rather than a percent-escaped intermediate string.
Fresh JSON results, prototype-looking keys as ordinary data, and current/app malformed-input comparisons.

caller.scope: One default-import caller in src/@mock-utils/api/authApi.ts reads the mock-user id after its separate mock signature check. No production authentication adoption is claimed.
